title.en: Which building pump prints an 80 mm delivery pipe?
title.zh: 哪一台建筑泵印了 80 mm 输送管？

description.en: Electric 20 prints 80 mm, with 1–2 cm aggregate, 120 m / 40 m and 8–10 m³/h. Do not copy that diameter onto Electric 30 or HBT80-16.
description.zh: 电动20印了 80 mm，骨料 1–2 cm，距离 120 m / 40 m，输送量 8–10 m³/h。不要把这个管径抄到电动30或 HBT80-16 上。

h1.en: Which building pump prints an 80 mm delivery pipe?
h1.zh: 哪一台建筑泵印了 80 mm 输送管？

directAnswer.en: Electric 20. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the delivery pipe diameter as 80 mm on that building and commercial model, together with aggregate 1–2 cm, 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa and 120 m / 40 m. HBT80-16 and HBT8018 print 100 / 125 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm on the compact rural row. An 80 mm line is an Electric 20 question.
directAnswer.zh: 电动20。邢台河北品锦机械在这台建筑与商业型号上把输送管内径印成 80 mm，同时是骨料 1–2 cm、22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa 和 120 m / 40 m。HBT80-16 和 HBT8018 印的是 100 / 125 mm。电动15在紧凑农村行上印的是 100–125 mm。80 mm 管路是电动20的问题。

heading.en: Pipe diameter is tied to the stone cell
heading.zh: 管径和石子格绑在一起

body.en: The same Electric 20 row limits aggregate to 1–2 cm. A mix that needs the 1–3 cm window of Electric 15, or the ≤ 3 cm window of Electric 30, is not automatically an 80 mm Electric 20 job. The frame is 900 kg, smaller than the 2300 kg Electric 40, which does not print 80 mm in its specification list.
body.zh: 同一行电动20把骨料限在 1–2 cm。需要电动15那种 1–3 cm 窗口，或电动30那种 ≤ 3 cm 窗口的料，不会自动变成 80 mm 的电动20工况。机重 900 kg，小于 2300 kg 的电动40。电动40的规格表没有印 80 mm。

heading.en: Replacement pipe is a separate catalogue

body.en: Straight delivery pipe, hose, elbow and clamp pages are spare parts. They are quoted after the pump model is known. This application note only says which pump prints 80 mm. It is not a parts list and it does not set a length or a price.
body.zh: 直管、胶管、弯头和管卡页面是配件。它们在泵型号确定后报价。这篇应用说明只说哪一台泵印了 80 mm。它不是配件清单，也不规定长度或价格。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: If you already own pipe, say the diameter. If you do not, ask whether 80 mm and 1–2 cm stone match the pour. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 如果已有管子，请写管径。如果没有，就问 80 mm 和 1–2 cm 石子是否对得上这次浇筑。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does every building pump use 80 mm?
question.zh: 每台建筑泵都用 80 mm 吗？

answer.en: No. Only Electric 20 prints 80 mm in the tables cited here.
answer.zh: 不是。这里引用的表里，只有电动20印了 80 mm。

question.en: Is DN80 clamp the same statement?
question.zh: DN80 管卡是同一句话吗？

answer.en: The DN80 clamp is a spare-part page. It is not proof that every pump is an Electric 20.
answer.zh: DN80 管卡是配件页。它不能证明每台泵都是电动20。

question.en: Can Electric 20 take 4 cm stone if the pipe is changed?
question.zh: 换了管子，电动20能打 4 cm 石子吗？

answer.en: The published aggregate cell is 1–2 cm. This page does not authorise a larger stone.
answer.zh: 已公布的骨料格是 1–2 cm。本页不批准更大的石子。
